method: Independent visual inspection of all 18 final main assets at their supplied reading dimensions; additional 480px checks on four labelled educational images. Cross-check of final source, attribution, licence and changes against Group A saved source metadata, Toshali source verification, local reuse provenance and nine retained generation prompts. No fresh external legal audit or browser-layout test claimed.

notes.detail: Nine original-art source URLs target GitHub main outputs/.../original-art/*.png. Include those retained originals in the publication commit or use another durable public source URL; local target files all exist.
Some generation prompt records still say visual_review=pending. This independent report records all nine as accepted; coordinator may reconcile status in the final provenance record.

limitations: Rights cross-review relies on already retrieved source-page evidence recorded by researchers; this pass checks consistency and does not claim a fresh online licence retrieval.
Illustrations are clearly labelled interpretive/conceptual and must keep those captions when displayed or reused.
No canonical files, source manuscripts or assets modified by this review.
